items.followUp: A vehicle starts from rest and travels 600 m in 60 s with uniform acceleration. Find its speed at the end of 60 s.

rubric.why: The initial speed, distance, and time are the given quantities needed to solve the problem.
rubric.description: Identifies the given data in SI units.
rubric.how: Award for stating u = 0 m/s, s = 1000 m, and t = 100 s.

rubric.why: This uniform-acceleration relation connects distance to the initial and final speeds.
rubric.description: Selects the appropriate equation of motion.

rubric.why: Correct substitution uses the SI values and initial speed in the selected equation.
rubric.description: Substitutes the given values into the equation.
rubric.how: Award for substituting 1000 m, 100 s, and u = 0 m/s into the relation.

rubric.why: The final speed is 20 m/s; both its numerical value and SI unit are required.
rubric.description: Calculates and reports the final speed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the numerical value 20 and 1 mark for the unit m/s.

modelAnswer: Given: u = 0 m/s, s = 1 km = 1000 m, t = 100 s.
